subject: The errand assistant versus the fussy customer
problem: A hypothetical busy household needs to compare two service appointments without losing control of booking.
workflow: Where available, switch from Chat to Task and ask for two local service options, opening hours and source links. Explicitly require approval before booking, calling or spending. Check the options yourself. Cast illustrates a hypothetical request; no actual test or completed booking is claimed.
result: A proposed comparison and approval workflow, not a measured success or time saving.
result_basis: Google vendor announcement of Tasks capabilities; proposed household scenario is hypothetical.
measurement_context: Compare quoted availability against the source and count corrections needed; no invented results.
source_quote: We’re also rolling out a set of advanced features, starting in the U.S.
limitation: Rollout varies by country/account; calling unavailable in Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Montana and Nebraska. AI may fail. No claim that instructions guarantee safety.
listener_action: Try a low-stakes comparison and check it before approving any external action.
availability: Free Tasks rollout in US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India; advanced features start in US.
